title: Hypothesis Set
description: IDEATE-stage artifact. Output of hypothesis-generator. A set of testable hypotheses generated from gap_classification + novelty_score inputs. Every hypothesis carries a non-blank falsifiable_prediction, a non-empty evidence_needed (each non-blank), and a non-empty evidence_ref (each non-blank, anti-slop binding to the source gap). A hypothesis missing/blanking any of these is schema-rejected.

hypotheses.description: Ordered list of testable hypotheses. minItems:1 ensures a non-empty set is produced.

statement.description: Declarative statement of what the hypothesis claims

falsifiable_prediction.description: Concrete, observable, falsifiable prediction — what would specifically be observed if the hypothesis is true vs false. Must contain a non-whitespace character (a blank prediction is not falsifiable). Mirrors rq_hypothesis_chain style.

evidence_needed.description: List of evidence types or experiments needed to test this hypothesis; each must be non-blank

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: references to the gap_id(s) or source(s) this hypothesis is generated from. At least one required; each must be non-blank.

source_gap_ref.description: Optional: the gap_id from gap_classification that triggered this hypothesis

depends_on.description: hypothesis_ids this hypothesis logically depends on
